text:
Frankfurt’s median asking rent stands at 17.5 €/m² in June 2026, up 3.2 % year‑on‑year and 24.4 % over the past five years, making it the second‑most expensive market among 37 cities. The 25‑day average time on market and a 31 % share of listings let within a week underline a tight market, while vacancy sits at just 1.9 %.

Asking rents are 65 % above the 2022 existing‑rent level of 10.58 €/m², pushing a typical 60 m² unit to 1 050 € per month and creating a rent‑burden of 21.4 % for two residents. The market’s tightness limits affordability despite a 4.01 % mortgage rate.

The model‑based forecast projects the median asking rent at 18.52 €/m² in 12 months, within a range of 18.0 – 18.96 €/m², implying a 5.8 % increase.
